question: Should PR 100461 land as the maintained Control UI composer/model-picker direction at live head acf6d174 after CI and current-head visual acceptance complete?
rationale: The code path is mechanically plausible and no blocking source defect was found, but the PR changes a broad user-facing chat surface under a maintainer label and the final visual/product direction cannot be decided deterministically.

options.title: Land after current-head acceptance
options.body: Proceed once relevant checks finish and a maintainer confirms the live-head composer, model picker, microphone input, and mobile behavior are the intended direction.

options.title: Request fresh proof first
options.body: Ask for updated screenshots or web chat proof against acf6d174 before deciding whether the visual redesign is ready.

options.title: Split or pause the redesign
options.body: Hold the branch if maintainers want the provider-picker/session fixes separated from the broad composer layout change.

recommendation.title: Land after current-head acceptance
recommendation.body: Proceed once relevant checks finish and a maintainer confirms the live-head composer, model picker, microphone input, and mobile behavior are the intended direction.

likelyOwner.reason: They own and are assigned to the live maintainer-labeled branch and authored the active redesign/fix iterations.
